hack.root_cause: ECDSA repeated k-value (same R signature) → MPC private key back-calculation
hack.description: AnySwap V3 lost $7.9M when its MPC key-signing software reused a random nonce after a restart, letting an attacker recover the private key via textbook ECDSA algebra.
